proposed_gates.requirement: Typed source/fixture/import/schema and affected regression tests exact HEAD; original tests and failure evidence unchanged.

proposed_gates.name: REAL_STORAGE_RECOVERY_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Genuine SQL/HTTP transactions, lock/lease/CAS, concurrent process, rollback, lost ACK, crash, restart and idempotent readback.

proposed_gates.name: NATIVE_PROVIDER_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Qualified provider/native/demo positive, refusal and UNKNOWN; actual owner account/env/instrument, fees and original effect readback. PAPER-only not sufficient.

proposed_gates.name: CONSUMER_AND_ANDROID_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Authenticated gateway→real owner→durable receipt→actual client; Android/emulator and spoken/overlay consumer tests, no native device claim yet.

proposed_gates.name: DATA_AND_ECONOMICS_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Point-in-time lineage, leak/cost/stress/forecast calibration/economic oracles, model/provenance and no profit claim absent OOS evidence.

proposed_gates.name: SECURITY_PRIVACY_POLICY_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Current owner grants and real service secrets; no cross-owner/cross-account/privacy egress; revocation, typed refusals, signing and audit.

proposed_gates.name: HOST_OPERATIONS_RECOVERY_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Real VM deployment isolation, cold start, backup restore, disk/capacity, observability, failover/rollback and approved SLO thresholds.

proposed_gates.name: EXACT_HEAD_CI_ZUUL_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: Trusted-base and DDS key, full applicable exact-head CI; Zuul genuine cross-repo speculative/Depends-On when selected; no mandatory failure/skip.

proposed_gates.name: INDEPENDENT_BACKEND_VERIFICATION
proposed_gates.requirement: All 12 original backend verification identities independently prove positive/adverse, native, integration and economic scope, not synthetic-only.

proposed_gates.name: GLOBAL_BG001_ISSUED
proposed_gates.requirement: 82 backend units +12 verification packets fully accepted under original PRE gates and dependencies; genuine issuer signs BG-001.

proposed_gates.name: UX_FE_CORRECT
proposed_gates.requirement: 3 UX +23 FE accepted with original actions and current backend contracts, static/emulator/accessibility tests; no premature physical claim.

proposed_gates.name: QA_DEVICE_RELEASE_AUTHORISED
proposed_gates.requirement: 5 QA +2 REL, signed real S24 Artemis proof and approved rollout/rollback; release and live capital separately authorised.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Valid request and signed current mandate
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Validate typed envelope, scope, original operation, mutable revisions, trusted now; commit via exact owning boundary.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Exactly one APPLIED receipt and durable independent readback.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Malformed, oversized, unknown-field or wrong API revision
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Refuse before state change; bound sizes, canonical Decimal/money and code/version enums.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: REFUSED_NO_EFFECT; unambiguous typed input error.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Unauthenticated, token expired, forged or replayed signature
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Check issuer/audience/session/device/nonce/current signer and purpose under lock.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: REFUSED_NO_EFFECT; sanitized audit, no secret leak.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Wrong owner, broker account, environment or product generation
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Bind physical native identity and cohort, not only display alias.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No cross-owner/account native reads or effects.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Mandate or temperament revoked after read but before send
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Recheck current policy, signer, lease and expiry at writer/send boundary.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: New risk blocked; existing protection remains eligible.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Wrong callback source or OAuth state collision
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Correlate exact nonce/operation/credential generation and original callback.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Reject adoption of legacy/unowned callback; original outcome available.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Consent, access, role or provider entitlement withdrawn
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Invalidate scoped current sources and consumer cache; retain legal original audit facts.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Access removed without deleting unrelated evidence or issuing new effects.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Duplicate same operation/same payload
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Resolve immutable idempotency key, scope and fingerprint before side effect.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Same receipt, exactly one state/event/provider effect.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Same idempotency key, changed payload
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Reject changed fingerprint, preserve first committed intent.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: CONFLICT; zero second effect.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Two processes competing for same lease/row
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Use actual SQL CAS/transaction and account/operation lock in canonical order.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Exactly one winner, second conflict/re-read; no double reserve.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Loss before transaction commit
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Rollback state/receipt/event and appropriate resource hold; safe retry only when no side effect.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: FAILED_BEFORE_EFFECT, no partial business state.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Lost ACK after local durable COMMIT
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Read original exact operation and immutable receipt after reconnect.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Recovered APPLIED/REFUSED; no duplicate transaction.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Provider timeout after possible send
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Retain PENDING/UNKNOWN and original native operation ID, poll/reconcile; never auto-resend ambiguous command.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: UNKNOWN_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED until native finality.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Restart during awaiting provider result
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Resume durable outbox/inbox and original readback from persisted cursor.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No lost claim, no duplicate dispatch.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Out-of-order, late or duplicate provider callbacks
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Check native ID, revision, causality clock and terminal transitions.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Duplicate ignored, conflicting effect flagged, original preserved.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Stale read or change between review and writer
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Re-verify actual resource revision/credential/account identity under writer lock.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Conflict/REFUSED; no stale-approval effect.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Clock reset, time skew or source freshness uncertain
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Use authoritative event/received/effect times; reject invalid expiry or unknown time.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No new risk, original historical facts unchanged.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Schema migration fails halfway
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Transactional migration with back-compat read/or rollback; no destructive unqualified cleanup.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Old state preserved; deploy blocked until recovery.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Missing balance, equity, commission or exchange rate
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Keep unavailable/UNKNOWN, never treat missing scalar as zero or trusted cash.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No new risk or false positive affordability.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Net deposits, withdrawal, transfer and provider reversal
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Separate external pending, settled native cash and historical flow basis; append corrections.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Exact conserved ledger, no duplicate funds.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Quote/beneficiary/fee changed after review
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Bind quote and participant digests to exact owner approval and check at send.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Expired/changed proposal requires new approval, prior state unchanged.

adversarial_cases.trigger: All-origin reservation race
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Atomic shared account/currency collateral accounting over manual, auto, child, pending and withdrawal origins.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Resource never oversubscribed; immutable reservations/release.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Position stop changed/partly missing
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Recalculate native money risk per confirmed leg; absent stop remains unknown.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Hard limits enforce conservative bound, no false protection.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Insufficient margin during partial order completion
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Reserve remainder, recheck against native fill and per-leg requirements.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No unbounded overfill; hedge/entry blocked as applicable.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Close request ambiguous while sibling protected
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Protect confirmed sibling independently, no resend of ambiguous leg close.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Family remains INCOMPLETE with original uncertain obligations.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Native fee correction/bust/late carry
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Append signed native correction with original deal association and as-of time.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Revised P&L/cost known only after native provenance.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Manual handover into automated lifecycle
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Bind manual operation identity and mandate; prevent dual active owners or lease overlap.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: One lifecycle owner, recoverable handoff.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Provider says zero effect after earlier UNKNOWN
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Require unique current native proof of no side effect before new authorized send.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Old claim reconciled, new action may be separately admitted.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Native tick/depth sequence gap, stale quote
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Require source sequence/snapshot and availability time; invalidate missing intervals.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: HISTORICAL/STALE, not executable quote.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Wrong instrument precision, venue or account binding
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Validate actual native symbol specification and contract units before conversion.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Reject unsafe scale/conversion, no order.

adversarial_cases.trigger: News arrives after decision but with earlier event time
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Use received/available time, immutable revision; prohibit hindsight.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Earlier decision unchanged, late data logged as later evidence.

adversarial_cases.trigger: News revised/retracted or entitlement revoked
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Invalidate dependent decisions and future eligibility while retaining historical vintage.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No silent backfill or unauthorized future use.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Strategy armed ticket clicked twice/reconnected
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Single-use durable original intent with current A4 and native confirmation.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: One ticket consumption, one original receipt.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Market closed, halted, depth incomplete, spread unstable
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Explicit NON_TRADABLE/UNKNOWN and bounded eligible route only.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No guess-based execution.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Partial feed outage during chart/alert
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Surface stale/unknown rather than fake zero/healthy data; backfill only with source-time evidence.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Correct freshness labels, no duplicate alert.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Replay/practice data references live broker
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Hard isolate sandbox account/keys and effect boundary.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No live capital effect; simulation provenance explicit.

adversarial_cases.trigger: PIT dataset uses record unavailable at prediction time
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Causal join and entitlement/available_at validation across all feature/label links.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Leakage test fails candidate, never admits dataset.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Randomized/shuffled labels appear predictive
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Negative oracle and chronological split/horizon holdout required.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No model promotion; underlying issue surfaced.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Cost/fees/slippage/principal unknown
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Retain unknown sensitivity and infeasibility, require native/economic source.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: INCONCLUSIVE/REFUSED, no promised profit.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Overlapping folds or model tuned on held-out period
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Frozen folds/trial manifest and independent review, reject leakage.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No inflated OOS score.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Forecast artifact signature/hash/version mismatch
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Verify exact data+feature+model+schema+weight hash before load/serve.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Unavailable/rollback; never execute untrusted model.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Stale forecast/cache drift/novelty threshold
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Check live source/model vintage, calibration and per-mode risk every decision.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No automatic trade from stale/confident-looking output.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Prospective challenger underperforms incumbent
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Compare realistically under same venue/fee/latency/availability policy, bounded shadow trial.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Reject/rollback with evidence, incumbent retained.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Research worker exhausts CPU/RAM/GPU or times out
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Enforce resource/cgroup/process cap, cancel owned process, store failed trial.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No hung server or silently successful experiment.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Chain reorganization or corrected settlement
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Bind finality depth, invalidate descendant facts and rerun causal dependent computation.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Unknown pending finality until qualified.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Prediction market event/contract mismatched
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Source-bound event and outcome/settlement semantics; no ambiguous cross-venue equivalence.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No arbitrage or probability claim from mismatched events.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Hermes or Muse run outcome unknown after send
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Reconcile single remote run id, idempotent inbox; no assumed `COMPLETED`.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: WAITING_EXTERNAL/UNKNOWN until original evidence.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Mission graph cycle/orphan/executor conflict
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Current scoped graph validation, no fictional critical duration.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: GraphIssue, no new action authority.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Browser prompt injection/SSRF/redirect or private context
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Deny-biased source classifier, origin lease and JEV proposal-only consent; final VAN validation.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: POLICY_DENIED, no private content/model egress.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Browser lost ACK after button submitted
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Recover observation/operation identity and current page/session state; avoid duplicate submission.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: UNKNOWN/reconcile, no blind second click.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Google access revoked, provider returns partial effect
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Per-scope vault and provider readback; invalidate expired cached ability.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Explicit disconnected/unknown, no fictitious send.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Voice segment delivered but not spoken
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Resume from device `last_spoken_segment`, not received cursor; dedup segment IDs.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No missing audio or restart from beginning.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Gateway restart during speech/automation
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Persist required original cursor/trigger/receipt or label unknown; cancel safely when unrecoverable.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No false COMPLETED or duplicate firing.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Cancelled automation fires on stale schedule
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Recheck current standing grant and cancellation under claim transaction.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: REFUSED_NO_EFFECT; cancellation wins.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Device offline or app crashes during original operation
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Persist non-secret original request and reconcile on authorized reconnect.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Correct original outcome without a new trade.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Cross-app overlay revoked/clips/touches trade area
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Respect window insets/IME/permissions, accessible safe fallback, never touch-modal on unrelated apps.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Usable safe UI, no inferred screen control.

adversarial_cases.trigger: APK/model/character source hash mismatch
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Fail closed at candidate review and release boundary; keep unadmitted assets separate.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: No production promotion or substituted visual.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Wrong runtime host, capacity exhaustion, failed backup
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Use installed qualified VM route, isolate worker, preserve volumes/receipts and verify off-host restore.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: Degraded but recoverable, no destructive cleanup.

adversarial_cases.trigger: Project Truth/DDS/CI mandatory check unavailable
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Preserve exact failed action and source fixes; recover prerequisite, do not waive or invent success.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: CI remains red until actual trusted input present.

adversarial_cases.trigger: S24 not connected or thermal/frame/soak failure
adversarial_cases.required_handling: Hold physical acceptance, retain emulator/CPU proofs separately; enforce real native acceptance last.
adversarial_cases.expected_observable: QA/REL NOT_ISSUED, previous version remains safe.

end_to_end_flows.name: Read-only onboarding
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Old admitted rights leak, wrong physical account, missing balance

end_to_end_flows.name: Restriction → reauth → promotion
end_to_end_flows.happy: Owner signs restriction→unique original recovery→READ_ONLY→separate governed activation
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Lost ACK, stale signer, changed reauth, incorrect autoenable

end_to_end_flows.name: Unlink retains money history
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Open order, pending withdrawal, shared credential, failed transport

end_to_end_flows.name: Funding and transfer
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Fee drift, double callback, partial refund, lost ACK

end_to_end_flows.name: Multi-origin risk account
end_to_end_flows.happy: Manual + auto + child pending orders share one exposure governor
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Race, undercollateralization, unknown stop or negative equity

end_to_end_flows.name: Native family lifecycle
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Unknown sibling close, opposite position, bust/late charge

end_to_end_flows.name: News D1–D7 to armed ticket
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Backdated feed, changed event, duplicate arm, revoked mode

end_to_end_flows.name: Manual trade and practice replay
end_to_end_flows.happy: Owner ticket uses current risk→native result; sandbox replay remains isolated
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Offline replay taken live, dual handover owner, unknown fill

end_to_end_flows.name: Sealed forecast-to-decision
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Leakage, stale feature, bad model signature, calibration drift

end_to_end_flows.name: Kalshi read-only research
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Mismatched event, stale price, unexpected live order

end_to_end_flows.name: Chain research finality
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Proxy upgrade, delayed reorg, untrusted wallet facts

end_to_end_flows.name: Mission → Hermes/Muse → result
end_to_end_flows.happy: Current scope→one assigned run→receipt→original inbox result→next task
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Timeout, conflicting result, duplicate executor claim

end_to_end_flows.name: Browser/JEV mediated action
end_to_end_flows.happy: Admitted public origin→bounded observation→JEV proposal→VAN revalidation
end_to_end_flows.adverse: SSRF, private prompt, stale selector, lost ACK

end_to_end_flows.name: Voice/knowledge/privacy
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Audio dropped, gateway restart, token revoked, data-retention conflict

end_to_end_flows.name: Standing automation + notifications
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Cancelled run, race, device offline, duplicate provider event

end_to_end_flows.name: VM crash and restore
end_to_end_flows.adverse: Disk pressure, partial snapshot, schema rollback incompatibility

end_to_end_flows.name: Android final acceptance
end_to_end_flows.adverse: No device, thermal overrun, wrong signing or artifact
